{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {df[df['customer_age'] == -1].shape[0]}")

# Check revenue dtype and sample values
print(f"Revenue dtype: {df['revenue'].dtype}")
print(f"Sample revenue values: {df['revenue'].head(10).tolist()}")

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {qa_orders.shape[0]}")

# Check status values
print(f"Unique status values: {df['status'].unique()}")

# Check for duplicated order_id
print(f"Number of duplicate order_id: {df['order_id'].duplicated().sum()}")"}
